correctness.rationale: The Fourier remainder has summable first derivative for all alpha>1. Its leading fractional cosine decrement and sine derivative yield the normalized cusp B, while strict mixture positivity makes the square-root reduction legitimate. The Hellinger shifts are established by dominated rescaling below alpha=3/2, a two-sided log integral at the boundary, and Sobolev translation differentiability above it. Truncated Fisher divergence has the exact exponent and coefficient. 106 finite numerical assertions passed; these are supplementary only.

value.rationale: This natural wrapped circular location model has a sharp model-specific failure of ordinary quadratic-mean differentiability, including an explicit critical h^2 log(1/h) coefficient, subcritical fractional constants and complete Fisher-information boundary. It discriminates precisely where regular parametric location calculations apply and is more than a change of notation or a cheap sign check. No downstream estimation theorem is claimed.
